details: Consequence of the max-over-subfamilies construction of monotonic Yang dimension.
proof: For every subfamily $\mathcal G\subseteq\mathcal H$, the Yang bound gives $\mathrm Y(\mathcal G)\le\mathrm E(\mathcal G)$.  Effective range is monotonic under subfamilies, so $\mathrm E(\mathcal G)\le\mathrm E(\mathcal H)$.  Taking the maximum over $\mathcal G$ yields $\mathrm Y^*(\mathcal H)\le\mathrm E(\mathcal H)$.
name: Effective Range / Monotonic Yang Dimension
